comments: 'The CH3000 headend optics platform - a 3RU, 19-inch mid-plane chassis for cable headend and
  hub optics, designed by Aurora Networks (2004), sold under the ARRIS name and now by CommScope / Vistance.

  the front; the rear of each slot takes the module''s dynamic back plate, which carries its optical and
  RF connections, or a half-depth passive. A mid-plane between the two carries the 12 VDC bus and the
  RS-485 management bus.

  and every other slot empty - the chassis powered and manageable before any optics are chosen. Empty
  slots are drawn open: the one front blank named in any document held, the BP3000, is neither drawn nor
  photographed (see gaps).
